title: Decide whether a carried acceptance failure follows the item that supersedes the failed one
outcome: Decide whether a carried acceptance failure follows the item that supersedes the failed one
acceptance: If it should follow, a test shows the replacement's show and evaluate carry it; either way docs/features/acceptance-evaluation.md R11 states the behaviour
The decision on whether a failure carried on a superseded item's run is shown to, or must be named by, the replacement item's next evaluation is recorded with its reasons
